rationale: Evaluation of revision 514fb091... (bundle repair-control-param-5ef2e2f3) passed all quality checks with zero framework fallbacks, yet was not accepted: paired TTFT regressed from 24.95 ms (parent) to 31.51 ms (~+26%, objective_not_improved, paired_gain_not_above_noise) while decode stayed roughly flat (decode_ms 695.5 vs 710.7 in the original reference measurement), so the added cost concentrates in the prefill/first-token window. Coverage shows the candidate routes ~145 operator groups as bitexact-l1 (count 4) plus bitexact-l1-gated (count 1) with 145 reference invocations, and these route labels are candidate-reported telemetry, not independent proof. The unresolved questions are: (1) whether those declared routes and the 4+1 gating split are real (corroborate with actual route/exception evidence on this exact candidate), (2) whether the ~6.5 ms prefill regression is host-side dispatch/gating overhead or genuinely longer device execution in the prefill window bounded by the explicit first-token-ready synchronize, and (3) how much of the whole invocation the binding layer alone costs, given binding was requested legacy but effective 'direct' (no functional replacements). candidate_diagnostics targets (1) plus per-route behavior within prefill; execution_timeline targets (2) via CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals in a separate plain trace; binding_cost targets (3) with clean AB/BA parent-vs-binding-only-passthrough workers on this additive candidate (parent still invoked per coverage, so it is applicable, and it will also run in subsequent candidate resource feedback). Excluded: torch (already ran; coverage.json shows all 66,441 kernels associated with no ambiguity), nsys (no graph-tracing/overlap question and no attribution gap left by the torch trace), nccl_tuning and collective_calibration (single-device task, no collectives), device_telemetry (device-wide NVML windows, nothing communication-related to attribute in a ~32 ms prefill), python_runtime (perturbing host profile; timeline plus binding_cost cover dispatch cost more cleanly). Revision is set to the exact evaluated candidate ID from revisions.json.
